connector.name: SearXNG HTTP MCP
connector.registryDescription: Self-contained SearXNG metasearch MCP server. One Docker image, 200+ engines, privacy-first.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image searxng-http-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the whw23 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: API_KEY
env.description: API key for authentication. Leave empty for no auth.
